# Measurement Scene State

> Public research archive for Measurement Scene State, Inverse-JEPA, and Dynamic-TTT.

Repository: https://github.com/KennyMcSimpson/measurement-scene-state
Public documents: https://kennymcsimpson.github.io/measurement-scene-state/

The repository is public. A missing keyword-search result does not establish that
a URL is inaccessible. Readers with URL-fetching support can read these files
directly. Search-engine inclusion is separate and is not guaranteed by this index.

## Read first

- [STATUS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KennyMcSimpson/measurement-scene-state/main/STATUS.md): Research status, evidence boundaries, and current records.
- [EXPERIMENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KennyMcSimpson/measurement-scene-state/main/EXPERIMENTS.md): Experimental protocols, results, and limitations.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KennyMcSimpson/measurement-scene-state/main/README.md): Repository overview and setup.
- [Repository map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KennyMcSimpson/measurement-scene-state/main/docs/handoff/REPOSITORY_MAP.md): Source and document navigation.
- [Research summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KennyMcSimpson/measurement-scene-state/main/docs/research_summary_20261003.md): Dated summary; consult STATUS.md for later records.

## Public website and text mirrors

- [Public document index](https://kennymcsimpson.github.io/measurement-scene-state/)
- [Core document text](https://kennymcsimpson.github.io/measurement-scene-state/llms-full.txt): Exact core Markdown documents combined into one text file.
- [Document and source text index](https://kennymcsimpson.github.io/measurement-scene-state/llms.txt)
- [Source code index](https://kennymcsimpson.github.io/measurement-scene-state/sources.html)
- [Structured file index](https://kennymcsimpson.github.io/measurement-scene-state/file-index.json)

The website is rebuilt from main when public documents or owned source files change.
No datasets, model weights, ignored outputs, or third-party source trees are copied.
